phase11.final_answer: The punishment for murder under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita is death or imprisonment for life, and a fine.
phase11.summary_answer: The punishment for murder under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) is death or imprisonment for life, along with a fine.
phase11.detailed_answer: Under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the punishment for murder is specified in Section 103. It states that whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to a fine (Section 103(1), Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023). Additionally, if a group of five or more persons commits murder based on certain discriminatory grounds, each member of the group is also subject to the same penalties (Section 103(2), Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023). Furthermore, if a person under a life sentence commits murder, they face the same penalties (Section 104 Body, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023).
